svg.text: OWP 帳本（aisoc/owp/）— 問責（Accountability）：每一步都寫帳本，先記帳、後動作

text.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono',Consolas,'Courier New',monospace

svg.text: 帳本事件（依發生順序）：detection → work_order → capability_grant → agent_egress → investigation_report → action_request → policy_decision → human_approval → authorization → action_receipt → verification_decision → acceptance_decision

text.font-family: 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Noto Sans CJK TC','Microsoft JhengHei','PingFang TC',sans-serif
